title: Freestanding paper towel holder 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade countertop organization with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass and designed to help keep surfaces tidy without wall mounting. Its weighted base helps prevent tipping, while a felt pad helps protect countertops from scratches—ideal for contemporary bath accessories and modern bathroom hardware looks that carry into the kitchen.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use
- Weighted base helps prevent tipping during tear-off
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on most surfaces
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Category: Paper Towel Holders
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 5-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
- Product weight: 4.8 lb
- Included: Paper towel holder
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
